quote: The objective is usually expected cumulative reward, not just the next reward.
Early estimates can be wrong, so always exploiting can lock an agent into an inferior policy.
Alpha controls the size of an update. Gamma discounts future rewards.
It did not prove the action is always best.
More powerful hardware can increase capacity or speed, but does not itself create a learning algorithm.
Capacity answers “how much fits?” Bandwidth answers “how quickly can it move?”
A motor driver or power stage supplies the current needed to move a motor or operate a valve.
High bandwidth does not remove propagation delay, queueing or server processing.
Measure the entire task, not just the advertised link rate.
Retransmitting lost data can add delay; interference and contention can reduce throughput.
“Real-time” does not simply mean very fast.
Training may occur centrally while a fixed policy runs locally.
A useful architecture keeps time-critical sensing, policy evaluation and actuator control near the device.
Continued operation must not be assumed.
A language may have both compiled and interpreted implementations.
A branch instruction may replace the normal next value of PC.
STORE copies 7 to address 200; it does not mean “store the number 200”.
